name: Bistro Thessaloniki
kurzbeschreibung: **Bistro Thessaloniki** in **Oberammergau** invites you to a culinary journey through the flavors of Greece and Bavaria. Enjoy authentic dishes like **Moussaka**, **Souvlaki**, and **Tzatziki**, paired with fresh Greek salads and traditional Bavarian specialties such as **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Obatzda**. The cozy atmosphere and warm hospitality make this bistro a perfect spot for a relaxed meal or a festive gathering. Whether you're craving Mediterranean sunshine or hearty Alpine flavors, **Bistro Thessaloniki** offers a unique blend of both worlds in the heart of the **Ammergau Alps**.
